svg.text: Desktop adaptation: the same four steps as one calm vertical stepper
One step open at a time
The open step gets the full 640 px column. The others fold to one line each: the coach’s opening
sentence. Read top to bottom, the folded rows still tell the story.
Same order as the phone
Fault, Why, Practise, Ask. The stepper rail on the left is the phone’s step bar turned on its side.
Nothing is added for the bigger screen.
The chat is everywhere, but lives last
“Ask the coach about this” sits under every open step. It opens step 4 with that step as context.
The thread itself only lives in step 4.
Proof stays on step 1
Key frames and the 7% live on the Fault step only. Later steps point back to them with the same
pins: [2] impact frame, [3] hip movement.
Finished steps become a summary
After step 3, steps 1–3 fold into one line of facts each. The coach’s answer can cite them without
the page repeating them.
Grounded, and says so
Pins in the answer match pins on step 1. The note under the composer is always visible:
answers come from this analysis only.
